newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's Anbeeco rises on talks news.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's Anbeeco rises on talks news.

text.p: Shares in South Africa's Anbeeco Investment Holdings ltd jumped on Wednesday following the firm's announcement that it is in talks on a possible deal.
The firm's shares rose 38 cents to a new year high of 230 cents in volumes of 335,700 shares.
In the statement released on Tuesday, Anbeeco said negotiations were still in progress which, if successfully concluded, could affect its share price.
Shareholders were advised to exercise caution in their share dealings until a further announcement was made. No further details were given in the brief announcement.
Dealers said players were getting into the stock on the back of the announcement, although details of the talks remained under wraps.
"It is all speculation. We have heard nothing solid," said one dealer.
